# RedisQueue.answers() method

Whether the broker answers this queue's writer within the given time.

**Signature:**

```typescript
answers(timeoutMs: number): Promise<boolean>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

true where a PING came back in time, false otherwise

## Remarks

A connection that only reports itself ready may sit on a socket nobody answers; this asks the broker itself. Never rejects.
